login.heading: Sign in
login.hint: Research prototype with fake accounts only. Real patient data must never be entered.

errors.invalid: The e-mail or password is not correct.
errors.notAllowed: This account cannot sign in. It may not be approved yet. Contact your clinic admin.
errors.locked: This account is locked for a while after too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.

sessionEnded.title: You were signed out
sessionEnded.body: Your session ended (it expired, or you signed out elsewhere). Sign in again to continue.
